title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E7 — Miriam Makeba/Muhammad Ali
Former heavyweight boxing champion Muhammad Ali, South African born singer Miriam Makeba and a three-man vocal group called the Delfonics, share the spotlight with guest-host Nikki Giovanni, who opens the show with her "Kidnap Poem".

title: Webster
description:
S2 E6 — Katherine Fights City Hall
The Papadapolis' and Webster all try and save the Tracadero diner from being demolished.

title: Webster
description:
S2 E8 — Moving On
Mystery and wonder are used to describe the new home George and Katherine are going to rent. This is a Victorian house replete with secret walls, openings, and more.

title: Webster
description:
S2 E9 — Thanksgiving Story
Webster, George, and Katherine are all trying to have a peaceful Thanksgiving. But things don't turn out the way they plan when George's aggressive father and Katherine's snobby mother arrive for Thanksgiving dinner.

title: Webster
description:
S2 E12 — Too Much Class
After Webster transfers to an advanced learning class, his grades start to slip.

title: Webster
description:
S2 E15 — Runaway
After she ran away seven years ago, Bill and Cassie's daughter returns to her parents.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E4 — Daddy's Girl
Tamera learns she's never too old to be a daddy's girl when she finds herself jealous of the growing closeness between Ray and Tia.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E5 — Sis Boom Bah
In a bid to boost their popularity at school, the twins try out for the cheerleading squad -- and Ray tries his hand at coaching them.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E6 — Kid-Napped
When a new girl in school threatens Tia and Tamera's popularity, the twins join forces to win back their friends with the help of a music superstar.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E7 — Boy From the Hood
Tamera falls for Tia's childhood friend Darnell, who's all grown up and running with a fast crowd.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E8 — I'll be There
Tia takes a job in a '50s diner to get away from Tamera and is shocked when Tamera starts working there, too.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E11 — To Sleep, Perchance To Dream
Moesha starts having recurring romantic dreams about Hakeem, giving her second thoughts about their friendship and about sharing a room with him and Niecy on an upcoming ski trip.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E12 — He Doth Protest Too Much
Moesha discovers that some of her college classes are more difficult than she thought; she has a hard time in Chemistry and reluctantly agrees to let Niecy tutor her.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E13 — Let’s Talk About Sex
Moesha crashes in Niecy’s dorm room after a late-night Pendulum party and is horrified to discover that Nicey has also let a male sleep in the room.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E14 — Secrets and Lies
The arrival of Frank’s Aunt Hattie brings a shocking revelation about Frank that turns the rest of the family – especially Dorian and Moesha – against him.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E15 — Color Him Father
Still reeling from the news that Frank is Dorian’s biological father, the Mitchells prepare for Dorian’s 17th birthday bash, a party that grows more and more elaborate and expensive as Dorian takes full advantage of Frank’s guilt.

S3 E20 — The Roommate
When Mary and Lester assume the role of temporary foster parents, they're horrified to find Sandra's erotic lifestyle rubbing off on the impressionable co-ed.

S3 E21 — Best Friends
When Mary's best high school chum, a successful television psychologist, pays her a visit, Mary feels somewhat inadequate when compared with her celebrity friend.

S3 E22 — The New Neighbors
The tenants are thrilled when Rose hires a live-in handyman for some much needed repairs, only to find he's handier with the violin than the toolbox.

S3 E23 — The Big Deal
Mary has a terrible time trying to be polite to Fox, who is rude and obnoxious yet potentially important to Lester's financial future.

description:
S2 E13 — It Almost Happened One Night
An old rival's visit causes Simone to pretend she and Malcolm are husband and wife.

An argument over whose room is largest lands Malcolm in the hospital.

Fired from her job and dumped by her girlfriend, Malcolm's sister arrives to stay with him and Eddie.
